title: Kitesurf (Cloudflare blog)
brief: Cloudflare's announcement of Kitesurf, a headless browser built for AI agents that runs entirely on Cloudflare Workers in V8 isolates instead of Chromium — optimized for token efficiency and scale on agentic tasks like screenshots and HTML extraction. The post walks through the engineering (Rust compiled to Wasm, Blitz/Stylo rendering, Chrome DevTools Protocol compatibility), reports 215,000+ Web Platform Tests passing, and availability free during beta inside Browser Run. Benchmark and conformance claims are vendor-reported and not independently verified.
caveat: Benchmark and conformance claims are vendor-reported and not independently verified.
